{
  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The study compares gene expression data and molecular interactions between mouse models and human patients for neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease, quantifying differences and similarities. It also analyzes the translation of drug efficacy (celecoxib) from mouse models to human clinical outcomes, providing a quantitative measure of concordance.",
  "arm": "disease-biology",
  "arm_evidence": "We have already shown the value of such approach for identification of disease-specific pathways in AD as compared to normal bioprocesses in the human brain [15], and Pappalardo et al. built computational model in immune system, which predicts how immune system activates in different conditions [16]. Motivated by these results, we sought to systematically model and mechanistically compare neuroinflammatory pathways specific to microglia, astrocytes, macrophages, and neurons between human and mouse in the context of AD.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "neurodegeneration",
    "sepsis-inflammation"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "Neuroinflammation is the hallmark of almost all neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs) including Alzheimer’s disease (AD) [ 1 ]. ... We sought to systematically model and mechanistically compare neuroinflammatory pathways specific to microglia, astrocytes, macrophages, and neurons between human and mouse in the context of AD.",
  "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "Based on the workflow illustrated in Fig. 1 , we have built neuroinflammation BEL models for human and mouse by extracting knowledge from literature, which are specific to three cell types in neurons: astrocytes, microglia, and macrophages; as they are actively involved in neuroinflammation.",
  "species": [
    "mouse",
    "rat"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "We retrieved 189 documents for mouse using the following query: { ((((([NDD:“Neuroinflammation”]) AND [MeSH Disease:“Alzheimer Disease”]) AND [Organism:“Mus musculus”]) NOT [Organism:“Rattus norvegicus”]) NOT [Free Text:“patients”]) NOT [Free Text:“human”] }. Similarly, 309 articles were harvested for human using the query { (((((((((([NDD:“Neuroinflammation”]) AND [MeSH Disease:“Alzheimer Disease”]) AND [Organism:“Homo sapiens”]) NOT [Organism:“Mus musculus”]) NOT [Organism:“Rattus rattus”]) NOT [Free Text:“mice”]) NOT [Free Text:“mouse”]) NOT [Free Text:“murine”]) NOT [Organism:“Rattus sordidus”]) NOT [Free Text:“rat”]) NOT [Free Text:“rodent”] }",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "To identify the concordance at the gene expression level between the two species, human and mouse, we have analyzed the representation of expressed genes in our models using gene expression datasets from Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) [ 20 ]. ... Analysis of failure of drugs on the basis of translation between species"
}
